notes:
- **refactor: Licensing model restructured to Core + Industry Packs** — replaced Free/Pro binary with Core (free) + Trades / Retail / Hospitality packs. `_CORE_CAPS` frozenset defines the accounting foundation; each pack adds its specific capability set. `TIER_LABELS` maps tier keys to display names. `_get_tier()` updated to return pack name from licence `tier` field; legacy "full/pro/invoices/cashbook/payroll" tiers map to "full" for backward compatibility. `FREE_UNTIL = 2026-09-30` still returns "full" for everyone during alpha — no user loses access. (`web/shared.py`)
- **refactor: Nav visibility uses `data-cap` attributes** — 8 nav items (Purchase Orders, Jobs, Schedule, Inventory, Fixed Assets, Warranties, POS, Table Service) now hidden via `data-cap` + a generic JS loop in `dashboard.html` rather than individual `payroll_enabled`/`pos_enabled` checks. Payroll still uses its own `payroll_enabled` flag (ATO-gated add-on). (`web/templates/dashboard.html`)
- **refactor: `/api/me` response fields updated** — `pos_enabled` now derived from `"pos" in tier_caps` (was `has_feature(lic, "pos")`); `pack` field added (tier key); `is_pro` set for any paid tier. (`web/routes/auth.py`)
- **refactor: Route gate error messages reference pack names** — jobs "Trades pack", inventory/backorders "Retail or Hospitality pack", fixed assets/warranties "Trades pack". (`web/routes/jobs.py`, `web/routes/inventory.py`, `web/routes/fixed_assets.py`)
- **refactor: Licenser tier dropdown updated** — Trades / Retail / Hospitality / Core (free) / Legacy Pro (all packs). (`licenser/templates/issue.html`, `licenser/templates/edit.html`)
- **docs: EULA v5.0** — Section 4 rewritten for Core + pack model: 4.1 Core (free), 4.2 industry packs defined, 4.3 alpha free to 30 Sep 2026, 4.4 early adopter $38 to 30 Jun 2027, 4.5 $19/month ongoing, 4.6 payroll add-on retained, 4.7 data ownership retained. (`EULA.txt`)
- **feat: Website pricing restructured** — Core card (free) + Industry Pack card ($19/mo with "Currently free" alpha badge) + 3-column pack grid (Trades / Retail / Hospitality with feature bullet lists). Hero note, comparison table, FAQ, and CTA updated. New `.pack-grid`, `.pack-card` CSS. (`dbox-website/index.html`, `dbox-website/static/css/site.css`)
